title: Attendance and Punctuality
description: Employees are expected to arrive on time and follow the company's working hours.

title: Leave Policy
description: Employees can request annual, sick, and emergency leave according to company rules.

title: Remote Work Policy
description: Employees may work remotely when approved by their manager and when their job responsibilities allow it.

title: Code of Conduct
description: All employees must behave professionally and respectfully toward colleagues, customers, and management.

title: Dress Code Policy
description: Employees are expected to maintain a professional and appropriate appearance during working hours.

title: Health and Safety Policy
description: Employees must follow workplace health and safety procedures and report any unsafe conditions.

title: Data Privacy Policy
description: Employees must protect company and customer information and must not share confidential data without authorization.

title: IT and Computer Usage
description: Company computers, software, and internet access should be used responsibly and mainly for work-related activities.

title: Anti-Harassment Policy
description: The company does not tolerate harassment, discrimination, or inappropriate behavior in the workplace.

title: Performance Review Policy
description: Employee performance is reviewed regularly to provide feedback and support professional development.
